title: A Visitor for the Harvest
author: Wren Okonkwo
blurb: Theo Brightwater, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
